title: Play a Sucker to Catch a Sucker - Seem Dumber Than Your Mark
coreMove: Lower the other person's guard by letting them feel mentally superior before the real move
sourcePressure: Chapter 21 is supported here by the frozen title and grouped secondary summaries: seeming less sharp or threatening than you really are can lower other people's guard, invite overconfidence, and create room to observe or move before they defend themselves properly.
